items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Smith--was he the one who danced on the vibes?

ctx.x: Yeah, you were young as a son of a gun, you're a little older now. Here's one where you're on tour with Bill Robinson, Bo Jangles. Ernie Fields' orchestra, Ross McLean, Jimmy Smith--was he the one who danced on the vibes?
